people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

translations.web: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore stood they before the king.
translations.bsb: And the king spoke with them, and among all the young men he found no one equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they entered the king’s service.
translations.kjv: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
translations.asv: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
